intent.proves: At least one image has language-specific rows with different, nonempty alt text in two languages.
intent.scope: image assets (file extension jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, avif or svg) of active products in scope; complete SQL enumeration

bindings.reason: get_product_images reads one product at a time; no complete host enumeration of details.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomDetails a WHERE a.DetailType = 0 AND (LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpg' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpeg' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.png' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.gif' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.webp' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.avif' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.svg') AND ISNULL(a.DetailLanguageId, N'') <> N'' AND ISNULL(a.DetailsName, N'') <> N'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetails b WHERE b.DetailProductId = a.DetailProductId AND ISNULL(b.DetailVariantId, N'') = ISNULL(a.DetailVariantId, N'') AND b.DetailValue = a.DetailValue AND ISNULL(b.DetailLanguageId, N'') <> N'' AND b.DetailLanguageId <> a.DetailLanguageId AND ISNULL(b.DetailsName, N'') <> N'' AND b.DetailsName <> a.DetailsName) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = a.DetailProductId AND p.ProductActive = 1{inScope})
